calls.title: DM + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting addressed DM's need for a new feature management system driven by complications from the absence of centralized feature flags leading to all-or-nothing releases. Pedro shared his experience of rollback incidents that could have been prevented with such a system. Attention was given to the shift from legacy systems to microservices, emphasizing the importance of feature targeting for gradual rollouts. The pricing structure of GrowthBook was discussed, including a fixed annual fee and user-based costs, along with options for scaling users. Due to compliance with Brazilian data laws, DM preferred a self-hosting solution. The session highlighted GrowthBook's scalability, demonstrated by Dropbox's high flag evaluation counts, and showcased features like attribute targeting and automated rollback capabilities. Next steps involve DM evaluating the findings and deciding on GrowthBook soon.
calls.keywords: Feature Flags, Progressive Rollouts, Compliance, Scalability, Pricing Model, Safe Rollouts
